title: Where a class's practice is read

steps.say: **Roster**, under **Manage class**, lists the pupils who have signed in as themselves and joined this class, one row each, with their belt, what they have learned, how much they have practised on that account and when they were last at it. Type a name into the search box to jump to one of them.
steps.terminal: This table counts only what each pupil did signed in as themselves. A class taught from the front with no pupil accounts has nobody here, and that is not a class that has done nothing.
